spans.s:
रेफ, अस्, m. a burr, burring or grating sound, the
letter र्; a cretic (see 3. र); passion, affection of
the mind; (अस्, आ, अम्), low, vile, contemptible;
[cf. रेप above.]
—रेफ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
containing a burring sound, having the sound of र्.
—रेफ-विपुला = र-विपुला, q. v.

रेफ रेफ, रेफस्, रेफिन्. See p. 846,
col. 2.

रेफित्वा, ind. having uttered a burring or grating
sound, having pronounced with the sound of the
letter र्.

रेफिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. containing a burring sound,
containing the letter र्, having the nature of र्.
